title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.12406v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.co

translated_title: FACTR 2：学习商用机器人手臂的外部力感知以提升策略学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.12406v2 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：接触丰富的操作任务需要力敏感性，但许多机器人手臂因专用力传感器成本高昂而缺乏该能力。我们提出了神经外部扭矩估计（NEXT），一种无需任何专用力传感器的数据驱动方法，用于估计外部关节扭矩。NEXT仅需10分钟的自由运动数据，训练1分钟即可达到与专用关节扭矩传感器相当的估计精度。NEXT能够在低成本手臂上实现力反馈遥操作，并通过力信息重采样训练（FIRST）提升策略学习，该方法在行为克隆过程中对接触前和接触片段进行过采样。在五个长时程任务中，FIRST在任务进展上比先前的力感知策略提高了超过17%。NEXT和FIRST共同将力感知遥操作和策略学习引入现成机器人，无需额外传感硬件。视频结果和代码可在 https://jasonjzliu.co 获取。
tldr: 本文提出NEXT和FIRST方法，无需专用力传感器即可实现低成本机器人手臂的力感知遥操作与策略学习，在长时程任务中性能提升超过17%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NEXT and FIRST methods that enable force-aware teleoperation and policy learning on low-cost robot arms without dedicated force sensors, improving task progress by over 17% in long-horizon tasks.
